categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies P2P message processing in src/net_processing.cpp for INV messages and peer disconnect logic on relay-disabled connections.
categories.rationale: Corrects INV message handling to strictly follow BIP 144 by ignoring MSG_WITNESS_TX announcements and fixes a check ordering bug that let peers avoid disconnect on tx-disabled connections by sending invalid announcement types. These are minor protocol conformance and enforcement fixes that do not address an active DoS or network-wide failure.
